name: UK GDAD PCF
description: An open, community-built companion to the UK Government Digital and Data (GDAD) Profession Capability Framework (PCF).

license.name: Open Government Licence v3.0
license.note: Role summaries are Crown copyright, adapted under this licence, with attribution required wherever they are republished. Everything else written for this repository is offered under the same terms.

notice: This is not a government service. Content beyond the role summaries is AI-assisted with human review. Nothing here should be the sole basis for a pay, grading, recruitment or promotion decision.

projects.name: uk-gdad-pcf-role-summaries
projects.description: The framework restated as plain text, one file per role level: the role, the level, its accountabilities, and its skills.

projects.name: uk-gdad-pcf-role-level-start-here
projects.description: A first orientation and learning pathway per role level, linking out to every sibling document.

projects.name: uk-gdad-pcf-upskilling-resources
projects.description: Courses, blog posts, research articles, videos and books for each role level.

projects.name: uk-gdad-pcf-continuing-professional-development-checklists
projects.description: A continuing professional development checklist per role level.

projects.name: uk-gdad-pcf-psychometric-assessments-by-assessor
projects.description: Assessor-administered cognitive, numeric, verbal and situational judgement items, with the answer key held back from the candidate.

projects.name: uk-gdad-pcf-psychometric-assessments-by-yourself
projects.description: The same four assessment types as practice material, for the reader to work through alone.

projects.name: uk-gdad-pcf-competency-assessments-by-assessor
projects.description: A skill-by-skill competency matrix, rated 0-4, for an assessor to judge a candidate or employee against.

projects.name: uk-gdad-pcf-competency-assessments-by-yourself
projects.description: The same matrix, generated from its sibling, for the reader to rate themselves against.

projects.name: uk-gdad-pcf-roles-skills-gap-forms
projects.description: A form human resources sends and an employee fills in, covering job tasks, skills, legal compliance and development priorities.

projects.name: uk-gdad-pcf-skills-self-assessment
projects.description: A standalone single-page tool for rating yourself against every skill in the catalogue, independent of any one role level.

projects.name: uk-gdad.github.io
projects.description: The SvelteKit project that publishes every document above as a static website.
